rule: Of the policies (P0 the threshold alone, P1 the text exemption, P5 the text exemption with the non-default parameter triggers, each with the budget trigger: a step whose reasoning was closed by force is routed) and the thresholds of the chosen signal, the (policy, threshold) with the lowest list-price cost per 100 items whose development success is at least the target; ties go to the higher success, then fewer routed items, then the lower threshold, then the policy listed first. When no point reaches the target, the one with the highest success whose cost per 100 items is within the cap, half of routing every item to B2; ties go to the lower cost, then fewer routed items, then the lower threshold, then the policy listed first, and the target is recorded as not reached (docs/m7-计划.md WP-K).

P5.label: text exemption + non-default parameter triggers + budget trigger
